Local storage is necessary. The browser will be refreshed.
Register your Game Sync ID in the Pokémon Global Link to use this feature.

You can get your Game Sync ID after you've reached a certain point in your adventure and have received the C-Gear in your Pokémon Black Version, Pokémon White Version, Pokémon Black Version 2 or Pokémon White Version 2 game. Here's how to get your ID. On your C-Gear, tap "ONLINE," then "GAME SYNC," or select "GAME SYNC SETTINGS" from the main menu. Once you have your ID, you can check it by selecting "GAME SYNC SETTINGS" from the main menu. Please register your ID when a Pokémon has been tucked in. You can register your Game Sync ID by clicking “My Page” and then “Game Registration.”
